# Figma Local Bridge

> Local, open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Figma Desktop. It lets an AI client read and edit the open Figma file through a bundled plugin and a localhost WebSocket — no Figma Dev/Full seat, no cloud API, no API key, no telemetry.

- Version: 0.30.0
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/Miart/figma-local-bridge
- Canonical README: https://github.com/Miart/figma-local-bridge#readme
- Operating guide: https://github.com/Miart/figma-local-bridge/blob/main/skills/figma-local-bridge/SKILL.md

## What it is

Figma Local Bridge connects any MCP stdio client (Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, and ChatGPT/Gemini clients with local MCP support) to the Figma desktop app. A Figma plugin holds one WebSocket per open file, one local daemon routes up to 16 files, and the MCP server exposes 43 tools. Everything runs on the machine.

Use it when the official Figma MCP server is unavailable, when the design file is only open locally, or when an agent needs guarded writes, visual review, design-token sync, checkpoints, or game/web exports.

## Capabilities

- Inspect and screenshot the open file; read metadata, layout, variables and selection.
- Build/patch keyed UI trees and batch-edit many nodes in one undo transaction.
- Author component variants and swap component instances with explicit loss reporting.
- Audit the design system (`audit-v2`) with exact local style/variable candidates.
- Save an iteration baseline and compare pixels + audit findings + structure (`figma_review`).
- Export, diff and import local Figma variables (`figma-tokens/v1` or DTCG).
- Checkpoint and rebuild a subtree, with a second verification dump.
- Export sprite atlases, 9-slice sprites, UI states and a web handoff bundle.

## Safety model

Mutating families default to a dry run and require the dry run's `planId` plus fingerprints. Targets are stable keys, not raw node ids. Batches and imports are one undo transaction and roll back on mismatch. `figma_use` is the raw Plugin API escape hatch and requires explicit destructive access and a scope. `FIGMA_BRIDGE_WRITE=0` makes the bridge read-only. Verification tools (`figma_audit`, `figma_compare`, `figma_review`, `figma_checkpoint`) report what changed rather than claiming intent.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20+
- Figma Desktop app
- The bundled development plugin (`plugin/manifest.json`)
- An MCP client that can launch a local stdio server

## Connect

Build the plugin and server, run `npm run daemon`, import the plugin in Figma, paste the daemon token once, then point the MCP client at `server/dist/index.js` over stdio.

## Important limits

- It is not the official Figma MCP server and is not affiliated with Figma, Inc.
- It uses the desktop plugin API, not the Figma cloud REST API; it cannot open a file that is not open in Figma.
- Cloud-only official tools (`create_new_file`, `generate_figma_design`, `generate_diagram`, `export_video`, shaders, Weave, cloud Code Connect sync) are not available.
- `figma_review` baselines are local files, not restorable checkpoints; use `figma_checkpoint` for restoration.
- `figma_tokens` manages variables, not paint/text/effect/grid styles.

## Keywords
